_experimental: #558 candidate C; documentation fixture only, not runtime schema

resolutionQuestions.structuralRole: A cell resolves its role from logical topology, then chooses the applicable palette by zone before deterministic weighted selection.
resolutionQuestions.sparseOverride: A named material override should bypass/override ambient palette selection for that semantic surface only.
resolutionQuestions.boundary: Adjacent cells in different palette zones must define which palette owns a shared wall face and how junction/profile material continuity behaves.
resolutionQuestions.procedural: Generated Maps need deterministic zone identity before palette resolution; palette choice must not consume gameplay RNG.
resolutionQuestions.authoringNoise: Zone assignment is only a win if it remains sparse/semantic rather than requiring every cell to carry a palette id.

observation: This avoids whole-tileset merge precedence but moves complexity to zone boundaries and shared faces. It is strongest when environmental differences already have meaningful authored/generation zones; it is weak if zones exist only to paint materials.
